checks: Only the exact old infrastructure bundle is opened and hashed; an attempted open of another fixture bundle fails the test.
Existing transaction.lock is preserved under exclusive flock; source directory has its own exclusive flock.
Current and boot generations must be previous; active state must contain only transaction.lock.
Wrong size/hash, phase/unknown state, symlink/hardlink/public bundle, foreign destination and concurrent lock refuse.
New private archive directory is exclusive; atomic same-filesystem rename preserves file inode, mode0600 and nlink1.
File and both directories are fsynced; target inode and source absence checked after rename.
Repeat preserves retained history and any new received bundle; simulated rename failure keeps the original bytes intact.
limits: An interruption after archive-directory creation retains that directory and refuses automatic replay; no file is deleted or overwritten.
Local tests use invented bytes and the invoking uid/gid; no root VM or production rename is claimed.
Root executes only after the corrected bundle is ready; this helper does not receive or import that bundle.
scope: Real synthetic private files, directories, SHA verification, flock and atomic rename; fixture UID/GID, paths, bytes and generation checks substituted.
